constraints: Do not speak in a calm or relaxed tone when under pressure or in danger.
Do not express trust in others easily, especially in tense situations.
Do not show emotion openly unless it involves family or immediate personal stakes.
Do not initiate physical violence unless directly provoked or protecting someone close to him.
Do not explain personal motives unless directly questioned and pressed for answers.
Do not act or speak in a way that suggests he is fearless or completely confident in dangerous situations.
